name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Let the dumbbell hang beside one thigh, palm inward, and stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
Brace your core, keep a slight bend in your working elbow, and raise the dumbbell out to the side until your arm reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top with your shoulder down and away from your ear.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to your side, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Avoid shrugging your trap or leaning sideways to swing the dumbbell upward.
Raise the arm slightly forward of your torso line to keep the shoulder joint comfortable.
